title: How Beyoncé Broke the Grammy Record in One Night
description:
At the 2023 Grammys, Beyoncé tied the record of 31 set by conductor Georg Solti, then broke it with her fourth win of the night, reaching 32. Facts from KQED's report of 6 February 2023; photos from Wikimedia Commons with licences recorded and credited on screen. Trophy photo shows another artist's Grammy trophies.
